name: Shifted billing dates
premise: A recurring monthly service posts a few days early or late.

name: Irregular billing
premise: A standing service contract renews on nonuniform dates at a stable price.

name: Similar descriptors
premise: One subscription changes its statement descriptor after two payments. An unrelated single purchase has a similar name.

name: UPI transaction noise
premise: Manual purchases from one shop occur at uneven intervals with varied amounts and no billing agreement.

name: One-time purchase lookalikes
premise: Separately authorized purchases happen to be monthly and share the same price and descriptor.

name: Incomplete history
premise: The customer has a subscription, but the visible statement includes only two of its charges.

name: Variable recurring amounts
premise: A subscription bills monthly with usage-based amounts. Every listed debit belongs to the same agreement.

name: Stable monthly control
premise: A stable subscription provides a regular-cadence control for the challenge cases.
